title: PRD interlock decision radar and sign-off runbook for private deployment upgrade
creator: Aisha Rao
description: Objective: Create an actionable interlock playbook (decision radar) that lists PRD-level open questions, who must sign off, failure modes, and acceptance gates for the Private Deployment upgrade (VPC + on‑prem installer). This ticket clarifies scope changes requested during the PRD review and tracks cross-team commitments (Engineering, Design, Legal, Security). Outcomes should remove ambiguity so engineering can estimate and schedule the upgrade with clear rollback and observability requirements.
acceptance_criteria: A single runbook stored in Confluence that enumerates decision points, owners, and required artifacts for sign-off
Legal has provided a signed list of dataflow constraints and required contract language for customers in regulated regions
Design has delivered final console mockups for the private installer flow and confirmed accessibility checklist items
Engineering has approved the compatibility matrix and produced a high-level rollout plan with canary thresholds and automatic fallback policies
Security/Compliance has confirmed KMS/HSM integration approach and approved the upgrade rollback trigger conditions
